# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and GDP for each country group
correlation_data = {}
for country_group in education_expenditure_data.index:
    # Extract the education expenditure and GDP data for the current country group
    education_expenditure = education_expenditure_data.loc[country_group].dropna()
    gdp = gdp_data.loc[country_group].dropna()
    
    # Calculate the correlation
    correlation = education_expenditure.corr(gdp)
    correlation_data[country_group] = correlation

correlation_data
